text:
All 6 acceptance examples landed:

* jmap-base-client/examples/session_fetch.rs (via .17.2, closed)
* jmap-server/examples/dispatcher_minimal.rs (via .17.3, closed)
* jmap-mime/examples/parse_eml.rs (pre-existing)
* jmap-mail-client/examples/mailbox_list.rs (via .17.4, closed)
* jmap-chat-client/examples/sse_listen.rs (via .17.5, closed)
* jmap-chat-client/examples/ws_loop.rs (via .17.5, closed)

Acceptance criteria verified:

* All 6 example files exist.
* All compile and produce sane output (verified runtime).
* Each is in the ~50-150 LOC range, reads as a narrative.
* cargo build --workspace --examples: clean (verified).
* cargo run --example NAME -p CRATE for each one: succeeds (verified).
* README.md for each affected crate has a one-line link to its examples/ directory.

Note on the title 'P2: 0 of 25 crates have examples/': stale framing. With this close, 5 of 29 crates (base-client, server, mime, mail-client, chat-client) have examples covering the workspace's most-likely-used entry points. The 6 acceptance examples listed above were the explicit deliverable; full per-crate coverage is out of scope (see .17.5 closure note about siblings).
